signInApps.confidential: With a secret (website with a server, e.g. WordPress)
signInApps.confidentialHint: Off only for apps in the browser or on a phone: they sign in with PKCE.
signInApps.deleteBody: The website can no longer sign anyone in with Hubra, and every sign-in ends.
signInApps.intro: Your website, forum or another app can sign members in with their Hubra account (OpenID Connect). Only active members of the club get in. The app learns name, email and membership (status, admin, groups) when the member agrees, and cannot read anything in Hubra.
signInApps.modalHint: Members sign in on your website with their Hubra account. The website reads nothing from Hubra.
signInApps.name: Name
signInApps.nameHint: What members see when signing in, e.g. “Club website”.
signInApps.onlyNowBody: Hubra keeps only a hash. Enter the secret in the website now; afterwards it can only be replaced.
signInApps.public: Without a secret: the website or app signs members in with PKCE only.
signInApps.redirectsHint: One per line, exactly as the website sends them (see the plugin’s guide). https only.
signInApps.renewBody: The old secret stops working at once. Until the new one is in the website, nobody can sign in.
signInApps.title: Sign in with Hubra
